subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw permanently bundle and own this Claude app-server runtime and executable, rather than improve the existing Anthropic, Claude CLI, and ACPX paths or keep it as an external plugin?
rationale: Code review cannot decide whether OpenClaw should add a second canonical Claude runtime with new public config, credential forwarding, persistent state, executable supply-chain, and long-term release ownership.

options.title: External plugin
options.body: Keep provider-specific runtime, auth, storage, and executable ownership outside core, landing only proven generic SDK seams.

options.title: Improve existing paths
options.body: Move the demonstrated auth, lifecycle, streaming, or recovery improvements into the current Anthropic, Claude CLI, or ACPX owners without adding a parallel harness.

options.title: Bundled ownership
options.body: Adopt the runtime and executable under OpenClaw ownership after dependency, migration, auth, sandbox, upgrade, and cross-platform proof.

recommendation.title: External plugin
recommendation.body: Keep provider-specific runtime, auth, storage, and executable ownership outside core, landing only proven generic SDK seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent current-main Claude session-fleet work and repository product boundary make this the strongest available owner for the runtime-direction decision.
